purpose: Every source actually retrieved and read for the Isuzu USA diesel 2000-2026 closure. Phase 1 and Phase 2 records may only cite sources whose authority_level is 'primary' and whose publisher is Isuzu Commercial Truck of America; everything else is corroboration and is marked as such.

source_policy.archived_capture_rule: An isuzucv.com page with no printed model year is evidence of what Isuzu published on the capture date. It supports the model year then current; it is never treated as proof of an adjacent model year.

sources.extraction_note: Text was taken with xpdf pdftotext in both -table and -raw mode; the two modes agree row-for-row. The -layout mode misaligns this document's columns by whole rows and was discarded. Two rows were independently confirmed against external listings of the same Isuzu numbers (8-98018858-0 as the 4JJ1 lube filter and 1-13200-487-2 as the 6B/6H lube cartridge) before the table was trusted.
sources.scope_restriction: The YEAR and ENGINE columns are this document's own published scope. They must not be widened to a model unless separate Isuzu model-year evidence links that exact model to the published engine and range.
